insight.title: The Architect Who Refused to Build Sidewalks
insight.subtitle: How leaving a university campus unpaved created the perfect walkway design.
insight.notificationHook: An architect left his campus unpaved

sections.text: When building a new university campus, an architect left the space between buildings completely unpaved, planting only grass.
Instead of guessing human behavior, he waited a full year. He let thousands of students walk across the lawn, carving natural dirt paths through daily use.
At the end of the year, he simply poured concrete directly over those worn paths, creating a walkway network where nobody ever took shortcuts.
People don't follow perfect plans; plans must follow human nature.
